verdict.rationale: Restate's own hosting docs offer three ways to run it: its Cloud service, a managed Restate region inside your own cloud account (BYOC), or self-hosting the single binary on your own machine, VM or Kubernetes. That lets users control where durable state and journals live. However, no documentation explicitly covers region selection or data-residency guarantees, especially for Restate Cloud. missing for 10: documented region selection for Restate Cloud, explicit data-residency/compliance documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can use Restate Cloud, run a managed Restate region in your cloud account with Restate BYOC, or operate Restate yourself.
making it easy to run it on a variety of platforms, from your local machine, to a VM, to Kubernetes.
